messages:
Maria: Heads-up — opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/client/pull/482 to bump the upstream client and it touches tool-calling param ordering. Locally all unit tests pass but the integration suite on CI is flaky. Can someone spare a quick :eyes: before the merge window closes?

Samir: taking a look now. which integration is failing? any error logs?

Maria: it's the toolcall end-to-end spec. CI shows mismatched arg serialization in the call payload. paste of failing line below from the runner:```
E   AssertionError: expected payload params to be ordered [prompt, tools, metadata] but got [tools, prompt, metadata]
```

Deepa: hmm that ordering should be transparent to the server but we do dependency-driven serialization in client v2. maybe the bump reintroduces dict-ordering reliance. @Samir can you repro locally with the E2E fixture?

Samir: repro attempt: clone + checkout branch + run `pytest tests/e2e/test_toolcall.py::test_tool_sequence` — I see the same failure. quick patch idea: normalize params with an ordered list before serializing.

Jon: fwiw I hit similar once when upgrading the streaming pipeline, the fix was a tiny serializer shim, not a large API change. if you have a patch I can run through CI.

ci-bot: Build #6142 for PR 482 — integration: failed (toolcall-e2e), unit: passed, logs uploaded: https://ci.redwood/6142/logs

Samir: proposed patch:```diff
- payload = dict(params)
+ payload = OrderedDict((k, params[k]) for k in ["prompt","tools","metadata"] if k in params)
  body = json.dumps(payload)
```
If no objection I'll push as a tiny follow-up commit. Also added a quick unit to assert stable ordering.

Deepa: please add a one-line comment linking the ordering to server expectations. we should also add a short note in the changelog under breaking-changes? even if it's tiny, mention to ops.

Maria: I'll add the changelog blurb. can someone +1 the patch once it's up so I can merge in today's window? :pray:

Jon: will run CI on your next push and give a +1 if green.

Samir: pushed fix + unit + comment. CI kicked off.

ci-bot: Build #6143 for PR 482 — integration: running, unit: running

Samir: pinging @Deepa for quick review of the comment/changelog wording.

Deepa: quick look — wording is fine, minor nit on phrasing, left inline. feel free to address or I can squash after merge.

ci-bot: Build #6143 for PR 482 — all checks passed.

Jon: ran an integration smoke locally, looks clean. +1 from me.

Maria: awesome, thanks everyone. merging in 10m unless any objections. will follow up with release note. :tada:
